LanguageData.VGE_TheGravship.label: The Hellion
LanguageData.VGE_TheGravship.description: Your Hellion engine is burning out. You managed to drift into an empty patch of orbit to bleed off the heat, but the cooldown cycle is excruciatingly slow. You know your pursuers are right behind you. It is only a matter of hours before their Hellion drops into your local space and the boarding action begins. You must fortify your aircraft, patch up your crew, and prepare to repel boarders. If you survive, the space is yours.\n\nNote: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.
LanguageData.VGE_TheGravship.scenario.parts.GameStart:
Your Hellion engine is completely overheated from the chase. You managed to drop into this empty pocket of orbit to bleed off the heat, but the emergency cooldown cycle will take hours.

You are not safe here. Your pursuers are tracking your signature, and their Hellion will drop into your local space soon. They will not hesitate to breach your hull.

Use this time to patch up your crew, fortify your aircraft, and prepare to repel boarders. Once the engine cooldown finishes, select the pilot console and launch to escape.
